actors.description_ref: local hosts interacting within default domains on a private IP space
active network nodes identified and mapped by hardware MAC address to logical IP address
target hosts whose ARP tables are altered
captures plain-text DNS queries on UDP Port 53
web traffic for reddit.com and gql.reddit.com

steps.text: Local hosts interact within default domains on a private IP space.

expected_indicators.indicator_description: Traffic between local hosts and default domains in a private IP space.

steps.text: Active network nodes are identified and mapped by hardware MAC address to logical IP address.

expected_indicators.indicator_description: Mapping of active network nodes by MAC address to IP address.

steps.text: The Kali host exposes its presence via network broadcasts.

expected_indicators.indicator_description: Network broadcasts from the Kali host indicating its presence.

steps.text: The Kali host broadcasts a continuous stream of unsolicited ARP reply packets across the local network without prior requests.

expected_indicators.indicator_description: Unsolicited ARP reply packets from the Kali host across the local network.

steps.text: Forged ARP packets alter the target hosts' ARP tables by mapping the default gateway's IP address and the victim's IP address directly to the attacker's MAC address.

expected_indicators.indicator_description: Forged ARP packets mapping IP addresses to the attacker's MAC address.

steps.text: The attacker captures plain-text DNS queries on UDP Port 53.

expected_indicators.indicator_description: Plain-text DNS queries captured by the attacker on UDP Port 53.

steps.text: The attacker monitors HTTP and HTTPS web interactions, exposing API endpoints and web traffic for reddit.com and gql.reddit.com.

expected_indicators.indicator_description: HTTP and HTTPS web interactions monitored by the attacker.

steps.text: TLS handshakes reveal clear-text Server Name Indication (SNI) fields inside Client Hello packets and reflect DigiCert-issued digital certificates for the target domains.

expected_indicators.indicator_description: TLS handshakes revealing SNI fields and DigiCert-issued certificates.
